newsitem.title: USA: Enron says S.D. gas compressor still shut.
newsitem.headline: Enron says S.D. gas compressor still shut.

text.p: Enron Corp said a gas compressor station on the Northern Border natural gas pipeline is still shut and will likely reopen later Monday.
Northern Border, a subsidiary of Enron, earlier Monday told Reuters the station, near Aberdeen, South Dakota, had returned to service after being shut over the weekend to repair a valve.
"The station is still off line. It is expected to be back on line later today," a company spokeswoman said.
"It is not affecting deliveries," she said, noting current volumes moving on the Northern Border system are 1.7 billion cubic feet per day (bcf/d).
